description: Single Chip Module with NXP Secure Smart Card Controller of P5CD081 Family and NXP Java Card and GlobalPlatform OS JCOP 2.4.2 R0. P5CD081 Family comprises: P5CD145 V0A, P5CC145 V0A, P5CN145 V0A, P5CD128 V0A, P5CC128 V0A, P5CD081 V1A, P5CC081 V1A, P5CN081 V1A, P5CD051 V1A, P5CD041 V1A, P5CD021 V1A and P5CD016 V1A.
